answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 150795 Country: India Title: Eating Food at parties Question: Myself working in Corporate IT industry where party is organized for employees in restaurant where alcohol is serve, so eating food where alcohol is serve is halal for us? Can we have dinner in a restaurant where alcohol is serve? Answer ID: 150795 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 772/712/SD=8/1438) Yes, it is allowable to eat halal things in such place at the time of need, however avoiding such parities is better for the safety of one’s faith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
